note: 過ぎる has a standard temporal sense glossed to pass or elapse; the English definition explicitly says pass or move by, and trôi qua is natural for time.
シュート (JMdict ent_seq 1061990, sense 0) is a する-verb glossed shooting a ball or a shot at goal; it fits the sports scoring sense missing from weapon-focused 撃つ.
投げつける (JMdict ent_seq 1447350, sense 0) is glossed to fling or hurl at and conveys the forceful or quick movement absent from general 投げる.
将来 (JMdict ent_seq 1347710, sense 0) is glossed future and future prospects; it covers a general future time better than from-now-on これから.
漫画 is the ordinary Japanese word for comics, and manga in English and Vietnamese specifically denotes comics originating in Japan.
こだま (JMdict ent_seq 1807610, sense 0) is glossed echo and reverberation and more directly names a reflected sound than general 反響.
クラブ has an association sense: JMdict ent_seq 1243910, sense 0 glosses club, fraternity, and clubhouse; the packet's golf gloss is a different sense of the same Japanese word.
ニスを塗る is the natural verb phrase for applying varnish; JMdict ent_seq 1091150, sense 0 glosses ニス as varnish, while 塗る supplies apply.
電池 and pin are standard general terms for devices storing electricity; the definition does not restrict the device to a particular battery size or use.
混ぜる is glossed to mix and blend and naturally covers bringing ingredients together; the definition itself also includes the broader senses mingle and unite.
hiệp ước usually denotes a treaty between nations; thỏa thuận is the general Vietnamese equivalent for an agreement, pact, or covenant.
布団 is Japanese bedding with a floor mattress, matching the thin mattress sense described; the definition is the Japanese-origin futon rather than a sofa-bed use.
ため息をつく is the everyday verb phrase for sighing; its noun base ため息 (JMdict ent_seq 1597190, sense 0) is glossed sigh, unlike formal 嘆息する.
xâm phạm usually means to infringe on rights or territory; vi phạm is the normal Vietnamese verb for breaking or disregarding a rule.
課題 (JMdict ent_seq 1195820, sense 1) is glossed homework and assignment and also covers coursework; 宿題 is limited to homework.
砕く means to break into pieces, crush, or shatter, fitting the transitive sense of causing an object to become two or more pieces; làm bể is natural Vietnamese.
血管 means a blood vessel and excludes plant vessels in the English definition; no single verified natural Japanese term for both plant and animal vessels is clear.
裏返す means turn over or inside out, while the English definition centers on positioning by folding or using folds; no verified direct replacement is established.
便利 (JMdict ent_seq 1512610, sense 0) is glossed convenient and handy; 手頃 usually means suitable or reasonable in price or size.
ドラム (JMdict ent_seq 1088890, sense 0) is glossed drum, drums, and drum kit; it is more general for the instrument than traditional 太鼓.
指 means a digit of the hand or foot, and the definition explicitly limits it to the hand; ngón tay is the exact everyday Vietnamese term for a finger.
写し (JMdict ent_seq 1321790, sense 0) is glossed copy and duplicate and is a more natural Japanese noun for an identical copy than rare loanword デュプリケート.
飛び込む is the standard Japanese verb for plunging or diving into water; the usual diving motion is head-first, matching the definition's typical action.
最年少 (JMdict ent_seq 2006790, sense 0) is glossed youngest and can identify the youngest member of a group; người trẻ nhất is not limited to a family's youngest child.
北極 and bắc cực are standard terms for a celestial body's northernmost point; the stated astronomical domain excludes Earth's geographic North Pole.
南極 and nam cực are standard terms for a celestial body's southernmost point; the stated astronomical domain supplies the non-Earth reference.
売上高 (JMdict ent_seq 1661980, sense 0) is glossed sales, amount sold, and proceeds, matching turnover as sales revenue better than transaction volume 取引高.
昼寝する is the ordinary Japanese verb for a nap, and the definition says especially during the day rather than restricting naps to daytime.
美味しい (JMdict ent_seq 1486650, sense 0) is glossed delicious and tasty and is more neutral for learners than colloquial うまい.
プレス機 (JMdict ent_seq 2851660, sense 0) is glossed press and pressing machine and better covers a device applying pressure than squeeze-specific 圧搾機.
像 (JMdict ent_seq 1403110, sense 0) is glossed statue, figure, and picture and covers statues made by molding or casting as well as carving.
ライド is commonly limited to an amusement ride or cycling event, while the packet gives no definition to select a general ride sense or a verified replacement.
言い渡す directly covers formally telling, announcing, sentencing, or ordering someone, matching the authority-driven announce sense represented by the English gloss list.
交渉 (JMdict ent_seq 1272110, sense 0) is the ordinary general noun for negotiation, talks, and bargaining; 折衝 is more formal and often tough bargaining.
きっと (JMdict ent_seq 1003430, sense 0) is glossed surely and undoubtedly; さぞ is limited to an empathetic supposition about someone.
果たす (JMdict ent_seq 1192850, sense 0) is glossed accomplish and achieve and is a more general verb than struggle-focused 勝ち得る.
それと naturally connects another point with and then or in addition; this matches the conversational conjunction sense represented by the entry.
中庭 naturally means an enclosed courtyard, and sân is a common Vietnamese term for a yard or court; the definition includes a courtyard as its example.
以前 (JMdict ent_seq 1155150, sense 1) is glossed previously and before; it is more general than duration-focused かねて.
首相 and thủ tướng are standard translations for chancellor in Germany or Austria, where the role is the head of government.
